description: Enables Diagram blocks in TmNotionEditor. When supplied, users can create and edit diagrams in a full-screen modal powered by TmEDiagramEditor. Without this provider the Diagram block type is hidden from the slash menu.

methods.name: GetDiagramDocumentAsync
methods.description: Loads a diagram document by ID. Returns null if the document does not yet exist.

methods.name: SaveDiagramDocumentAsync
methods.description: Persists a diagram document and returns the saved version.

methods.name: CreateDiagramDocumentAsync
methods.description: Creates a new empty diagram document and returns its ID along with the document.
